general_finding: For any actual five-net with a fixed-ray transversal T, its induced 56-point component line graph has spectrum 30^1,(-2)^7,3^28,(-5)^20. If B is the actual 56-by-40 component-line incidence, V=ker B^T is exactly the (-5)-eigenspace; its projector Pi has diagonal 5/14. The actual 56-projector Gram is H=J/7+K with K=Pi K Pi, K>=0, diag K=6/7 and tr K=48. Therefore D=K-(12/5)Pi has trace0/diagonal0, and for each collinear x,y its entry is (m_xy-3)/10 where m_xy counts common T neighbours. Consequently tr K^2=576/5+||D||_F^2, with ||D||_F^2 >= (1/100) sum_ordered_collinear (m_xy-3)^2. No rank-one/physical lift is assumed for the scalar relaxation.
affine_finding: For ANY affine five-net on F8^2 whose fixed transversal T is a line of a sixth unused affine direction, the net incidences force the ordered squared-deviation sum >=672. Normalize T:y=0 and the five directions x+c_i y=const, c_i distinct. A class-i line has neighbour-difference set D_i={c_i+c_j:j!=i}; all its collinear pairs have m=3 iff D_i is a (7,4,2) multiplicative difference set. Writing S=sum c_i and T2=sum_{i<j} c_i c_j, the elementary classification of cyclic (7,3,1) difference triples gives this iff S+c_i=0 OR T2=(S+c_i)^2. Frobenius is injective, so at most two of the five directions satisfy it. Every bad direction contributes at least four bad ratios and 56 ordered pairs per ratio, giving >=3*4*56=672. Thus any physical C7 witness on this net has ||D||_F^2>=168/25; the isotropic Gram K=(12/5)Pi is impossible on the whole affine-line-transversal subclass.
remaining_gap: This rules out only an isotropic projector-Gram ansatz, not a physical C7 witness with anisotropic K and not general/nonaffine five-nets. The actual phase-sensitive Kcomplex Hadamard lift, all 7D Q bases, C8 and original q1 remain open.
